PACTO_DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace Pacto delivery runs in, whose published identity policy the dashboard reads

PACTO_DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_TRUST.description: Trust config delivery records are verified with, so History reads signed records (the recorder's PEM public key or a YAML trust config)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_MIRA_URL.description: Mira's address, to link health-check citations

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: OpenID Connect client id of the dashboard

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OpenID Connect client secret of the dashboard

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_EXTRA_SCOPES.description: Space-separated scopes beyond openid, profile and groups

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_ISSUER_URL.description: OpenID Connect issuer people sign in with before the dashboard shows anything; every view then follows their Kubernetes RBAC

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL.description: The dashboard's /auth/callback as browsers reach it
